description: List the built-in capability type templates: each type's name, version, description, parameter count, parameter group names and a base price hint. NOTE: these describe types, not operators' offerings, and carry no assurance tiers or availability. The gateway does not read the query, so it never narrows the list. Registered capabilities of a type are listed by GET /api/capabilities?type=<type>.

query.description: Optional and not used: the gateway returns the full list whatever you send.

name: search_capabilities
